method: Category A (standard price paid) sales only, by transfer date. Medians and quartiles (inclusive method) in whole pounds; null when a window has fewer than 5 sales (a quality threshold: every sale is already published by HM Land Registry). The newest months are revised as late registrations arrive. Not an index: the mix of homes sold changes from period to period.
